description: Edit audio: trim, convert format, merge files, adjust volume, change speed, extract from video, reverse, fade in/out. Requires ffmpeg.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

files.description: Array of file paths to merge (merge).

format.description: Output format: mp3, wav, ogg, flac, aac, m4a (convert/extract).

input.description: Absolute path to the input audio (or video for extract). Not required for merge.

name: media_audio_edit
